item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 14/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry easterly airstream, the weather will be mainly fine and windier over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The easterly airstream is expected to be gradually replaced by a southerly airstream during the weekend and early next week. The weather will become unsettled over the coast of southern China. There will be showers and a few thunderstorms.

Weather: Cloudy with one or two showers at first. Mainly fine and dry during the day.
Temp range: 23 - 28 C
R.H. range: 50 - 85 per Cent
